description: Variation of condition 4 (hours of opening) of 01254/4-6/P6 approved 07/05/2019 for the change of use to place of worship to allow start time at dawn.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of permission 01254/4-6/P6 approved on 07/05/2019.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Transport Statement dated February 2019, received: 05/03/2019. Email Statement from Mark Pender received: 02/05/2019. 7257/01 Rev D, 7257/02 Rev D, 7257/03 Rev D, 7257/04 Rev D, 7257/05 Rev D, 7257/06 Rev D, 7257/07 Rev D, 7257/08 Rev D, 7257/09 Rev D, and 7257/10 Rev D, received: 03/05/2019. 7257/01 and covering letter dated 24th February 2020. Received: 25th February 2020 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The building shall be used for D1 (Place of Worship) use and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification). Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting the order) no change of use of the D1 unit shall be carried out.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for D1 (Place of Worship) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times: dawn to 23:00 hours Monday to Saturday and dawn to 22:00 hours Sunday and Public and Bank Holidays for a maximum period of two years from the date of this permission after which hours of operation shall revert to 07:00 to 23:00 hours Monday to Saturday and 09:00 to 22:00 hours Sunday and Public and Bank Holidays, unless otherwise first agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority, no amplified sound shall be played that is audible outside the premises at any time and the doors to the premises shall be kept shut at all times other than for access.

Condition : 5 - Before first occupation of the building hereby approved, the cycle parking spaces and the access to them shall be provided in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing 7257/08 Rev D and such spaces shall be permanently available for the users of the building(s) without obstruction.

Condition : 6 - The operators of the premises shall inform the Local Planning Authority in writing at least one month before any large events (including festival events intended to attract more than the usual daily worship attendances) attracting numbers are planned to be held at the site so that the level of local disruption can be monitored during the extended hours of operation.
